## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` and `ruff check .` pass

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (Unreleased) for user-visible changes
- [ ] Anything that sends content to a third party is reflected in `docs/privacy.md`

- [ ] I have agreed to the [Contributor Licence Agreement](../CLA.md), and any third-party code is named with its licence
